rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial Hong Kong term for a person who does carpentry.

example.english: We hired a carpenter to build the cabinets during our home renovation.
example.traditional: 我屋企裝修，請咗個鬥木佬嚟整櫃。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 zong1 sau1 ceng2 zo2 go3 dau3 muk6 lou2 lai4 zing2 gwai6

rows.note: Use this more formal term when referring to the traditional trade or in more careful speech and writing.

example.english: A carpenter in the old days would hand-finish every piece of furniture.
example.traditional: 以前嘅木匠會親手打磨每一件傢俬。
example.jyutping: ji5 cin4 ge3 muk6 zoeng6 wui5 can1 sau2 daa2 mo4 mui5 jat1 gin6 gaa1 si1
